name: pdk-ckan-async-search-indexing
instr:
Our CKAN portal needs dataset editing to stay available while Solr is unavailable, and search maintenance must not undo live changes during a rebuild. Extend the CKAN checkout at `/app` so committed dataset changes are indexed asynchronously by `ckan jobs worker`; dataset writes must not need a successful Solr request. PostgreSQL, Redis and Solr are available in the container setup. The deliverable is the changed source tree under `/app`, including any migration and Solr schema changes needed for a fresh installation.

Requirements:
- `package_create`, `package_patch`/`package_update`, `package_delete` and `dataset_purge` commit their database changes even during a 20-second Solr outage. Workers attempt pending Solr updates during the outage (within 12 seconds of a pending write) and reconcile every dataset written during that outage within 45 seconds of recovery; normally `package_search` reflects creates, edits, deletes and purges within 30 seconds. A `dataset_index_status` action takes `id` (dataset UUID or name) and returns `id` and a numeric `lag`, with `lag == 0` only after the latest committed change is indexed (including deletion and purge).
- Concurrent workers cannot let an older Solr request overwrite a later committed edit, or restore a purged dataset, even when the older request is held in flight until after the later one completes. `ckan search-index rebuild` must obey the same ordering when it races a live edit. Existing Solr documents without application index
